heading: top-center
name: 兩張大卡片並排（上方圖片帶、標籤壓在交界、橫跨按鈕）
desc: 置中標題組下方兩張等寬等高的大卡片，幾乎橫跨畫面寬；卡片上半部是貼齊卡片邊緣的底色圖片區（圖片在其中內縮），小標籤壓在圖片區下緣，底部一顆橫跨整張卡片的按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。標題組下方留較大空白，接著是兩張並排的卡片，等寬、等高，兩張合起來幾乎橫跨整個畫面寬，左右只留少許邊，比標題組寬得多。每張卡片的上半部是一塊底色和文字區不同的寬幅圖片區，這塊底色區貼齊卡片上緣與左右兩側；圖片放在底色區內，四周保留內距，不貼齊卡片邊緣（可放單張圖片，或一大搭配數小的圖片組合）；下方的文字區保留內距；文字區內容靠左：一個小標籤壓在圖片區下緣靠左的位置，跨在圖片區與文字區的交界上，重疊約一半；其下是標題（可多行），再下方是一行前面帶小圖示的次要文字，沒有時省略；卡片最下方是一顆按鈕，橫跨整張卡片的寬度，兩張卡片的按鈕位在同一高度。
mobile: 標題組仍在上方置中；兩張卡片改為直向堆疊，每列一張，依原本順序上下排列；卡片內部結構不變：圖片區在上，底色區貼齊卡片上緣與左右兩側、圖片在其中保留內距，小標籤仍壓在圖片區下緣，下方依序是標題、帶小圖示的次要文字和橫跨整張卡片的按鈕。

en.name: Two large side-by-side cards (image band on top, label on the seam, spanning button)
en.desc: Below a centered heading group, two equal-width, equal-height large cards nearly span the viewport width; the top half of each card is a tinted image area flush with the card edges (images inset within it), a label overlaps the bottom edge of the image area, and a button spans the whole card at the bottom.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group, after a fairly large space, are two cards side by side, equal in width and height, which together nearly span the full viewport width with only a small margin on the left and right, much wider than the heading group. The top half of each card is a wide image area with a background different from the text area; this background area is flush with the top edge and the left and right sides of the card, while the images sit inside it with inner padding on all sides, not flush with the card edges (either a single image or one large image with several small ones); the text area below keeps its inner padding; the text area content is aligned left: a label overlaps the bottom edge of the image area on the left, sitting on the seam between the image area and the text area and overlapping it by about half; below it is a title (may wrap to multiple lines), and below that a line of secondary text preceded by a small icon, omitted when there is no content; at the very bottom of the card is a button spanning the full width of the card, and the buttons of the two cards sit at the same height.
en.mobile: The heading group stays at the top, centered; the two cards are stacked vertically, one per row, in their original order; the inner structure of the cards is unchanged: the image area on top, its background area flush with the top edge and the left and right sides of the card and the images inside it keeping inner padding, the label still overlapping the bottom edge of the image area, followed by the title, the secondary text with a small icon, and the button spanning the full width of the card.
